Sentence (English): I want to start by saying this dishwasher itself is amazing!
Comments (English): [ Stylish design and extra space ] || ---------------- || I want to start by saying this dishwasher itself is amazing! I love the extra drawer that helps keep the smaller items contained. It's amazing that they were able to provide this extra space with the same general size format of a standard dishwasher. The design is sleek, and i really like the stylized handle. The red sides on the handle weren't my favorite as they didn't match my kitchen, but Kitchenaid made the inserts very easy to remove for the purpose of paint-matching your kitchen. The controls are pretty easy to operate, albeit very sensitive (you can accidentally hit one after making your selection). The unit comes with a fair amount of sound dampening insulation so it helps tremendously with noise levels. Most of the things that i think could stand improvement relate to the installation itself. The only thing with the dishwasher i think could use is more secure insulation. The way it is loosely covering it makes it conducive to bunching up when being installed in the tight space usually alloted for a dishwasher. When it came to the installation, the unit was delivered on time and with ease. However, the installers refused to utilize my air gap that was installed, choosing to bypass it instead because they didn't have the correct clamp. I even offered one of my own as i keep these type things on hand in my garage, yet they still refused. This led to me having to uninstall and reinstall the drain lines myself to make sure this necessary feature was installed (an air gap ensures there is no backup from a garbage disposal into a dishwasher's drain lines). Fortunately I have the experience to do this on my own. Next, they failed to use the hole drilled through the inner cabinet wall to route my water line, and instead ran it through a cutout for my sink. This led to the water line being stressed and squished between the dishwasher and cabinet instead of laying nicely behind the unit like it should. The buttons/controls for the machine are on the top of the door instead of the front. Nice clean concept, except the installers set the height at the highest level. This placed the controls 1/8 inch away from the countertop making seeing and using the controls impossible. This led to me having to pull the entire unit out to set the legs to proper height. The final mishap of the installers came from their trial run to make sure it all worked. Well, they left the paper tags inside the dishwasher. It took over an hour removing all of the filter screens and flushing the drain lines to remove clumps of wet paper. All in all, the dishwasher is great. It works fantastically, it looks great in the kitchen i am currently remodeling, and the extra drawer is a fantastic upgrade. The installers could use more training, though.

Sentence (English): I had been putting off buying a dishwasher for a long time, but I finally got it this time.
Comments (English): I had been putting off buying a dishwasher for a long time, but I finally got it this time. I needed to renovate the sink, so I had it done through a partner company and installed it the next day. The work was done neatly and the installer kindly taught me how to use it and maintain it. I did it once and then turned it on for the first time in automatic mode. In the past, I couldn't do anything while washing dishes, but thanks to the dishwasher, I can make eye contact with my children for 10 more minutes and play with them, so I'm so happy. After washing with the dishwasher, it dries with hot air, so I can put the dishes away right away. After everything was done, the dishes were clean and shiny, and I trusted the performance. I was a little surprised to see that the transparent dishes that I didn't wash by hand were clean. I've heard a lot of people around me say that the quality of life changes with just one dishwasher. I'm so happy to have experienced that. #EventParticipation

Maybe the water pressure needs adjustment or we need to change cleaning mode. We don't rinse dishes prior to loading. I wish that the control panel was more intuitive and that there was a physical indicator that the cleaning cycle was complete. Notifications come on our phone only. Otherwise, we continue to be impressed with the Bosch machine, recommend to others and would buy again...but hopefully not for another 12 years.

Even though we are a family of four, it is sufficient and works well! If I run it after breakfast and leave, the door opens automatically, so everything is dry. It’s so nice to be able to wash the dishes from dinner when I get home and then relax! On weekends, I wash dishes from every meal. Sentence (English): While using the S* 6-person dishwasher that I had been using before, I felt that the capacity was insufficient as my children grew up, so I bought an LG dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Previously used S* 6 person dishwasher ] || ---------------- || While using the S* 6-person dishwasher that I had been using before, I felt that the capacity was insufficient as my children grew up, so I bought an LG dishwasher. Since my parents were already using it, I didn't consider other companies' products from the beginning, and only considered LG products, but the problem was the color selection. The kitchen cabinets have a unique silver tone, so I had a lot of trouble with the color, but it looks exactly like it was custom-made. I was so surprised and proud. Needless to say, the functions were great and excellent. All the parts that I felt were lacking in the existing product were completely resolved. High-temperature washing, true steam, and hot air drying. Since I have young children, I have to pay special attention to their health and hygiene, and I am really satisfied with this part. In addition, with the addition of the water softener, rinse, hot air drying, and automatic door opening functions, there were almost no stains or remaining moisture. If you put cups and dishes with chins in the lower tray, and take them out starting from the lower tray after all work is done, and then take out completely dried dishes in order, you can completely avoid the issue of residual moisture. I love that the work I used to do twice a day, or at most three times, in front of the kitchen has been reduced to once before going to bed and once in the morning to clean and dry the dishes. In addition, the noise is so low that it’s surprising that it’s actually running. The installation technician’s kind explanation of the tip that if you accidentally drop a dish, you can pause it by opening the door slightly and restart it by putting it back in. ^^. Anyway, I’m very satisfied! #EventParticipation
Comments (Original): [ 이전에 사용하던 S* 6인용 식기세척 ] || ---------------- || 이전에 사용하던 S* 6인용 식기세척기를 쓰던 중, 아이들이 커가며 용량이 부족함을 느끼게 되어 LG 식기세척기를 구입하게 되었습니다.부모님댁에 이미 사용하고 계셨기에, 다른 회사 제품을 처음부터 생각하지 않고, LG것만 생각하고 있었는데, 문제는 색상 선택이었습니다.부엌 수납장 색이 독특한 실버톤이라 색상에 있어서 고민 많이 했는데, 맞춤으로 한 듯이 똑같네요. 너무 신기하고 뿌듯했습니다.기능은 말할것도 없이 너무 좋고 훌륭했습니다. 기존 제품에서 부족하고 느꼈던 모든 부분이 완벽히 해결되었네요.고온 세척에 트루 스팀, 그리고 열풍 건조.어린 아이들이 있다보니 건강과 위생에 특히 신경써야 하는데, 이 부분에 정말 만족 합니다.게다가 연수 장치, 린스, 열풍 건조, 자동 문열림 기능까지 더해지니 얼룩도 잔 물기도 거의 존재하지 않았습니다.턱이 있는 컵과 그릇은 하단 트레이에 넣고, 모든 작업이 끝난 후에 하단 트레이 부터, 그리고 완전 건조된 식기부터 차례차레 꺼내면 잔여 물기 이슈도 완전히 자유로울 수 있습니다 하루에 두번, 많으면 세번 이상씩 부엌 앞에서 있던 일이, 자기 전 한 번 돌리고 아침에 깨끗하게 건조된 그릇을 치우는 일 한 번으로 줄어든 것이 너무 좋네요.게다가 소음도 너무 적어서 정말 돌아가고 있나 신기할 정도이기도 하고요.아차 하고 놓친 그릇도 살짝 문을 열면 일시정지, 다시 넣으면 재가동 된다는 방법도 설치 기사님의 친절한 설명으로 알게된 꿀팁이네요 ^^아무튼 대 만족입니다!!#이벤트참여

Sentence (English): This is our second Bosch dishwasher and we love it.
Comments (English): [ Bosch is our favorite brand of dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is our second Bosch dishwasher and we love it. It works well and has a lot of features. When we ran our brand new 800 series dishwasher for the first time, it was empty, no dishes but with a full pre-rinse dispenser, per the instructions. We discovered the dishwasher emitted a nasty industrial odor like asphalt or tar during the wash cycle. We did some internet research and found other Bosch owners had encountered the same issue and noted their suggestion that it would eventually go away with regular use. To speed things along and get rid of the smell quickly, we placed one cup of white vinegar in a saucer on the bottom rack inside an empty machine and ran the heavy cycle + sanitize. When the cycle finished, we then sprinkled a cup of baking soda on the bottom of the empty dishwater and ran a heavy+sanitize cycle again. We performed this deodorizing duet several times over several days, interspersing empty load washes with fully loaded dishware, and ALWAYS checking that the filter was clean before doing another load. Finally, the odor dissipated after around two weeks and life was good again.

Comments (English): [ very quiet, limited status info displayed ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher is very quiet, and it has a very clean look because the controls are hidden on top.There is a tiny blue light on the front which tells when the dishwasher is finished, but there's no obvious way to tell where it is in its cycle if it's not completely finished. The standard cycle takes between 2 and 3.5 hours to complete, depending on how dirty the dishes are when they're loaded. The debris trap in the bottom, which needs to be cleaned every month or two, is very easy to reach and maintain. The moveable middle shelf is easy to move, which is often necessary depending on the heights of the things loaded in the bottom and middle shelves. The soap dispenser is very well designed, closing securely and operating reliably when it's time for it to open during a cycle. I have found that dishes and flatware need to be more thoroughly scraped (than with our previous dishwashers) to come out clean, but I've noticed that glasses look cleaner (less fogged) than with previous dishwashers. We're using the same rinse agent as we've always used. The standard heat-dry cycle seems less effective than with our previous dishwasher, but I have not yet tried the available "extended drying" cycle, since it requires more time and uses more energy.

Sentence (English): Reason for purchase.
Comments (English): [ Reason for purchase: As I was raising a baby, the dishes were endless. Especially when I was putting the baby to sleep and thinking about cleaning up, since we mostly eat, the dishes for the baby and the dishes for the adults took 40 minutes to 1 hour. ] || ---------------- || Reason for purchase. Raising a baby, the dishes were endless. Especially after putting the baby to sleep and thinking about cleaning up, since we mostly eat, there were dishes for the baby and the adults that would take about 40 minutes to 1 hour to wash, so I looked into a dishwasher. Advantages. 1. Cost-effectiveness. I went around Electronics Land and Hi-Mart, but there was no product that I could buy for 800,000 won. Only Cuckoo is around that price, but the exterior material of Bespoke is much more luxurious. Also, the fact that the installation fee was free was really great. 2. Confirmation of installation possibility. The remodeling technician visited and thoroughly checked whether installation was possible or not. What I was most worried about was whether installation would be possible, but the remodeling technician told me that if installation was not possible, I could just cancel the purchase, so I had a pre-inspection with peace of mind. 3. Installation process. The installation process was very smooth, and both the pre-inspection remodeling technician and the Bespoke installation technician were very kind. I am satisfied with the fact that it keeps its time commitments well. 4. Dishwashing ability. It washes dishes very cleanly. Oily dishes are much cleaner and squeakier than when a person does them. 5. Time efficiency. Since you can just wash the dishes and rest, you can see that the housework is reduced by 50 minutes every day. It is the most satisfying electronic product I have ever purchased. Disadvantages - Honestly, I don't know the disadvantages. If I had to pick one, it would be that it doesn't fit the width of my shelf, so there is a little gap? It doesn't bother me. Oh, one suggestion? If I may share my thoughts, I think it would be more satisfying if the seller provided a sample of dishwasher detergent as a service so that I could try it out as soon as the product arrived. I am very satisfied overall. Everyone, buy a dishwasher with your own money.

Sentence (English): Purchased this unit in August 2023 and I have had nothing but issue after issue with it.
Comments (English): [ Poor Quality with breakdowns on major components ] || ---------------- || Purchased this unit in August 2023 and I have had nothing but issue after issue with it. A real shame as this is supposed to be a premium product. My previous dishwasher, also an LG, lasted 12 years and I never had any issues with it, unfortunately it eventually developed a leak and I decided to upgrade rather than repair it given its age. I made the decision to stick with LG based on my experience with my previous unit as well as the features available on this unit and I have regretted it ever since. First major issue started in May/June 2024, when the unit was about 9 months old, it started beeping constantly, switching off mid load and also beeping constantly when not even in operation. Had to eventually unplug it from the wall to get it to stop. Repair process took 3- 4 weeks in total and the control panel was replaced under Warranty, worth noting that this control panel is essentially the "brains" of the unit and didnt even make it through year 1.Fast forward a couple months and it then started tripping out the main board to the house repeatedly. I then tried a different programme which didnt trip the mains and managed to finish the cycle, however, it started throwing out an HE error code which according to the Troubleshooting section of the Manual, has to do with a faulty heating element. This was also evident from the soaked, ice cold dishes at the end of each wash cycle with undissolved detergent all over them. (Worth noting that each time something goes wrong with the unit, the wait for an engineer is 7 - 10 days, the engineer then arrives to assess the unit, once the unit is assesed, parts need to be ordered (another +- 1 week) and then once the parts have arrived, your repair appointment will be booked with another 7 - 10 day wait, so 3 - 4 weeks to get you up and running again each time something goes wrong) therefore with these 2 (major) faults, my new Dishwasher has been out of commision for 2 months (and counting) out of 13 months.Other issues with this unit are that the clips which hold the tines in place for the Smart Rack system (which enables rack adjustment for washing larger pots/ pans etc) have become brittle (most likely from heat) and one snapped about a month ago. Reported this to LG who then stated that the item was not covered by Warranty and that I would need to replace them at my own expense which is fair enough. What did surprise me though is that whilst they were happy to let me know the Part No. for the item, I was told to source it online myself using my preferred search engine as they dont seem to stock their own parts! Also, the coating on the tines is cracking and starting to peel off from repeated clipping and unclipping when raising and lowering the tines. So make use the Smart Rack sysem at your own risk, youll be replacing your lower rack in no time at all, at your own expense to boot! The upper spray arm has also developed a convex "bow" to it and is no longer able to rotate freely as each end of the spray arm is now scraping against the underside of the top rack and gets stuck. So if dishes loaded into the upper rack come out just as soiled as when they went in, check your upper spray arm. (You're welcome! )It would seem that the raw materials used to manufacture the internal plastic bits is very sub standard and essentially "not fit for purpose". To add insult to injury,the costs of replacing these parts will be for the customers account, but to be fair, LG will provide you with the part numbers to source these yourself as previously mentioned.The engineer that attended to assess the most recent issue actually recommended that, due to all of the issues we have experienced and the major parts requiring replacement, he would recommend an exchange.This request was denied by LG (not surprised considering they weren't prepared to replace the £3.00 clips that snapped)I am very dissapointed in the product quality and would not recommend it all.(See pictures & video attached for reference)

Sentence (English): I was using the S* 6-person dishwasher that I had been using before, but as my children grew up, I felt that the capacity was insufficient, so I bought an LG dishwasher.
Comments (English): I was using the S* 6-person dishwasher that I had been using before, but as my children grew up, I felt that the capacity was insufficient, so I bought an LG dishwasher. Since my parents were already using it, I didn't consider other companies' products from the beginning, and only considered LG products, but the problem was the color selection. The kitchen cabinets have a unique silver tone, so I had a lot of trouble with the color, but it looks exactly like it was custom-made. I was so surprised and proud. Needless to say, the functions were great and excellent. All the parts that I felt were lacking in the existing product were completely resolved. High-temperature washing, true steam, and hot air drying. Since I have young children, I have to pay special attention to their health and hygiene, and I am really satisfied with this part. In addition, with the addition of the water softener, rinse, hot air drying, and automatic door opening functions, there were almost no stains or remaining moisture. (If you put cups and dishes with chins in the lower tray, and take them out starting from the lower tray after all work is done, and then take out completely dry dishes in order, you can completely avoid the issue of remaining moisture.) It's so nice that the work that used to be done twice a day, or at most three times, in front of the kitchen has been reduced to once before going to bed and once in the morning to clean and dry the dishes. In addition, the noise is so low that it's surprising that it's actually running. The installation technician's kind explanation of the tip that if you accidentally drop a dish, you can pause it by opening the door slightly and restart it by putting it back in is a great tip ^^. Anyway, I'm very satisfied! #EventParticipation

Sentence (English): My dishwasher finally arrived!
Comments (English): [ Essential Appliances! A Vertically Elevated Quality of Life ] || ---------------- || My dishwasher finally arrived! My friends said it was so good and insisted I get one, but since I don't eat much at home, I didn't want to waste money on water, electricity, and detergent, so I just washed it. The size is perfect for a three-person household like ours, for six people. Seriously! It was supposed to arrive the next day, but the installer called to say they were so behind schedule that they couldn't make it on the scheduled date. I waited another day and had it installed the next morning. I think it would be better if Coupang only took reservations for the amount of installation they had available. I was home for two days waiting. The installation took about 30 or 40 minutes, and the installer was incredibly kind! He even brought a drop cloth to cover the floor beforehand, and he even packed up all the boxes for me to take away. The control panel buttons are so intuitive that I didn't even need to read the manual to use it. There are buttons for power, start, course, lock, auto door open, and remaining time. The course is simple with 4 options. Sterilization and drying (used when sterilizing and drying baby bottles with high temperature water, no need to add detergent) Low temperature 60 degrees (for dishes that may become deformed when washed at high temperatures) Power 75 degrees (for washing heavily soiled dishes) Normal 75 degrees (for washing lightly soiled dishes) On the far right is the remaining time and a round light. The red light indicates above 60 degrees and the blue light indicates below 60 degrees. Personally, I think it would be good to have a quick mode! So that you can easily rinse things like glass cups. The automatic door opening function is really essential! If you leave it with the door open and full of moisture, there will be a unique watery smell. When there are about 3 minutes left to dry, it will automatically open and let it dry, so all you have to do is open the door and let it dry and you're done^^ I actually thought it would open wide because it said "door opening", but it opens only a little as shown in the attached photo. Since it is a product that is placed on the sink top, the drain hose is connected to the sink with bubble wrap. Since it is not built-in, there is nothing that can be done, but it doesn't bother me much, so I think it would be good to keep in mind. I was worried because it was my first time hearing of the brand Coupang Free AS 2-Year Media, but I think I can buy it with confidence since Coupang offers a free 2-year warranty^^ After installing it and using the dishwasher every day for a week, I don't know how I bought it until now. My kitchen is very small, so it would be burdensome to put a large product, but I like that it doesn't take up much space. The design is sleek and pretty, so I'm satisfied! Although we are a family of three, the child usually eats breakfast and dinner at home alone, so I think this is the perfect size for every meal. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Essential Appliances! A Vertically Elevated Quality of Life ] || ---------------- || My dishwasher finally arrived! My friends said it was so good and insisted I get one, but since I don't eat much at home, I didn't want to waste money on water, electricity, and detergent, so I just washed it. The size is perfect for a three-person household like ours, for six people. Seriously! It was supposed to arrive the next day, but the installer called to say they were so behind schedule that they couldn't make it on the scheduled date. I waited another day and had it installed the next morning. I think it would be better if Coupang only took reservations for the amount of installation they had available. I was home for two days waiting. The installation took about 30 or 40 minutes, and the installer was incredibly kind! He even brought a drop cloth to cover the floor beforehand, and he even packed up all the boxes for me to take away. The control panel buttons are so intuitive that I didn't even need to read the manual to use it. There are buttons for power, start, course, lock, auto door open, and remaining time. The course is simple with 4 options. Sterilization and drying (used when sterilizing and drying baby bottles with high temperature water, no need to add detergent) Low temperature 60 degrees (for dishes that may become deformed when washed at high temperatures) Power 75 degrees (for washing heavily soiled dishes) Normal 75 degrees (for washing lightly soiled dishes) On the far right is the remaining time and a round light. The red light indicates above 60 degrees and the blue light indicates below 60 degrees. Personally, I think it would be good to have a quick mode! So that you can easily rinse things like glass cups. The automatic door opening function is really essential! If you leave it with the door open and full of moisture, there will be a unique watery smell. When there are about 3 minutes left to dry, it will automatically open and let it dry, so all you have to do is open the door and let it dry and you're done^^ I actually thought it would open wide because it said "door opening", but it opens only a little as shown in the attached photo. Since it is a product that is placed on the sink top, the drain hose is connected to the sink with bubble wrap. Since it is not built-in, there is nothing that can be done, but it doesn't bother me much, so I think it would be good to keep in mind. I was worried because it was my first time hearing of the brand Coupang Free AS 2-Year Media, but I think I can buy it with confidence since Coupang offers a free 2-year warranty^^ After installing it and using the dishwasher every day for a week, I don't know how I bought it until now. My kitchen is very small, so it would be burdensome to put a large product, but I like that it doesn't take up much space. The design is sleek and pretty, so I'm satisfied! Although we are a family of three, the child usually eats breakfast and dinner at home alone, so I think this is the perfect size for every meal. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Essential Appliances! A Vertically Elevated Quality of Life ] || ---------------- || My dishwasher finally arrived! My friends said it was so good and insisted I get one, but since I don't eat much at home, I didn't want to waste money on water, electricity, and detergent, so I just washed it. The size is perfect for a three-person household like ours, for six people. Seriously! It was supposed to arrive the next day, but the installer called to say they were so behind schedule that they couldn't make it on the scheduled date. I waited another day and had it installed the next morning. I think it would be better if Coupang only took reservations for the amount of installation they had available. I was home for two days waiting. The installation took about 30 or 40 minutes, and the installer was incredibly kind! He even brought a drop cloth to cover the floor beforehand, and he even packed up all the boxes for me to take away. The control panel buttons are so intuitive that I didn't even need to read the manual to use it. There are buttons for power, start, course, lock, auto door open, and remaining time. The course is simple with 4 options. Sterilization and drying (used when sterilizing and drying baby bottles with high temperature water, no need to add detergent) Low temperature 60 degrees (for dishes that may become deformed when washed at high temperatures) Power 75 degrees (for washing heavily soiled dishes) Normal 75 degrees (for washing lightly soiled dishes) On the far right is the remaining time and a round light. The red light indicates above 60 degrees and the blue light indicates below 60 degrees. Personally, I think it would be good to have a quick mode! So that you can easily rinse things like glass cups. The automatic door opening function is really essential! If you leave it with the door open and full of moisture, there will be a unique watery smell. When there are about 3 minutes left to dry, it will automatically open and let it dry, so all you have to do is open the door and let it dry and you're done^^ I actually thought it would open wide because it said "door opening", but it opens only a little as shown in the attached photo. Since it is a product that is placed on the sink top, the drain hose is connected to the sink with bubble wrap. Since it is not built-in, there is nothing that can be done, but it doesn't bother me much, so I think it would be good to keep in mind. I was worried because it was my first time hearing of the brand Coupang Free AS 2-Year Media, but I think I can buy it with confidence since Coupang offers a free 2-year warranty^^ After installing it and using the dishwasher every day for a week, I don't know how I bought it until now. My kitchen is very small, so it would be burdensome to put a large product, but I like that it doesn't take up much space. The design is sleek and pretty, so I'm satisfied! Although we are a family of three, the child usually eats breakfast and dinner at home alone, so I think this is the perfect size for every meal. This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher lady finally arrived!
Comments (English): [ Essential Appliances! A Vertical Improvement in Quality of Life ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher lady finally arrived! My friends told me how great it was and insisted I buy one, but since I don't eat at home often, I felt like the cost of water, electricity, and detergent was a waste, so I just thought I'd wash dishes as usual. The 6-place setting is just the right size, making it perfect for a 3-person household like ours—really! Installation. They guaranteed next-day arrival, but the technician called to say that their schedule was backed up so they couldn't work on the scheduled date. I waited one more day, and they installed it right away the next morning. I think it would be better if Coupang had a system that only accepted reservations for the number of installations they could actually install. I ended up staying home for two days just waiting. The installation took about 30 to 40 minutes, and the technician was incredibly kind! They even brought a cloth to lay down to protect the floor during installation and cleaned up the remaining boxes to take away. Control Panel. The buttons are really intuitive, so you can operate it immediately without even reading the manual. It has Power, Start, Course, Lock, Automatic Door Opening, and Remaining Time. The courses are also simple, with only four options. Sterilization Drying (Used to sterilize and dry items containing baby bottles with high-temperature water; no detergent is required). Low Temperature 60°C (For dishes that may deform during high-temperature washing). Powerful 75°C (For washing heavily soiled dishes). Standard 75°C (For washing general, lightly soiled dishes). On the far right, there is a remaining time display and a circular light; a red light indicates the temperature is above 60°C, and a blue light indicates it is below 60°C. Personally, I think a Quick Mode would be great! So you can quickly rinse things like glass cups. Automatic Door Opening. This feature is truly essential! If you leave items full of water without opening the door, they develop a distinctive musty smell. The door opens automatically when there are about 3 minutes left to dry, letting the water drain out completely, so you just need to open the door, dry, and tidy up—that's it! I actually thought the door would open wide since it said "open," but as shown in the attached photo, it only opens a little. Drain Hose. Since this product sits on the countertop, the drain hose is connected inside the sink using suction cups. It is unavoidable since it isn't installed like a built-in unit, but while it doesn't bother me much, it is something to keep in mind. It comes with a 2-year free warranty from Coupang. I was worried because I had never heard of the Midea brand before, but knowing that Coupang offers a 2-year free warranty, I think I can buy it with confidence. Comments (English): [ Essential Appliances! A Vertical Improvement in Quality of Life ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher lady finally arrived! My friends told me how great it was and insisted I buy one, but since I don't eat at home often, I felt like the cost of water, electricity, and detergent was a waste, so I just thought I'd wash dishes as usual. The 6-place setting is just the right size, making it perfect for a 3-person household like ours—really! Installation. They guaranteed next-day arrival, but the technician called to say that their schedule was backed up so they couldn't work on the scheduled date. I waited one more day, and they installed it right away the next morning. I think it would be better if Coupang had a system that only accepted reservations for the number of installations they could actually install. I ended up staying home for two days just waiting. The installation took about 30 to 40 minutes, and the technician was incredibly kind! They even brought a cloth to lay down to protect the floor during installation and cleaned up the remaining boxes to take away. Control Panel. The buttons are really intuitive, so you can operate it immediately without even reading the manual. It has Power, Start, Course, Lock, Automatic Door Opening, and Remaining Time. The courses are also simple, with only four options. Sterilization Drying (Used to sterilize and dry items containing baby bottles with high-temperature water; no detergent is required). Low Temperature 60°C (For dishes that may deform during high-temperature washing). Powerful 75°C (For washing heavily soiled dishes). Standard 75°C (For washing general, lightly soiled dishes). On the far right, there is a remaining time display and a circular light; a red light indicates the temperature is above 60°C, and a blue light indicates it is below 60°C. Personally, I think a Quick Mode would be great! So you can quickly rinse things like glass cups. Automatic Door Opening. This feature is truly essential! If you leave items full of water without opening the door, they develop a distinctive musty smell. The door opens automatically when there are about 3 minutes left to dry, letting the water drain out completely, so you just need to open the door, dry, and tidy up—that's it! I actually thought the door would open wide since it said "open," but as shown in the attached photo, it only opens a little. Drain Hose. Since this product sits on the countertop, the drain hose is connected inside the sink using suction cups. It is unavoidable since it isn't installed like a built-in unit, but while it doesn't bother me much, it is something to keep in mind. It comes with a 2-year free warranty from Coupang. I was worried because I had never heard of the Midea brand before, but knowing that Coupang offers a 2-year free warranty, I think I can buy it with confidence. After using the dishwasher every day for a week since installation, I don't know how I lived without it until now. My kitchen is quite small, so placing a large product is burdensome, but I like that this one doesn't take up much space. The design is sleek and pretty, so I am satisfied! Although we are a household of three, my child mainly eats breakfast and dinner alone at home, and I think this is the perfect size to run the dishwasher right after every meal. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Essential Appliances! A Vertical Improvement in Quality of Life ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher lady finally arrived! My friends told me how great it was and insisted I buy one, but since I don't eat at home often, I felt like the cost of water, electricity, and detergent was a waste, so I just thought I'd wash dishes as usual. The 6-place setting is just the right size, making it perfect for a 3-person household like ours—really! Installation. They guaranteed next-day arrival, but the technician called to say that their schedule was backed up so they couldn't work on the scheduled date. I waited one more day, and they installed it right away the next morning. I think it would be better if Coupang had a system that only accepted reservations for the number of installations they could actually install. I ended up staying home for two days just waiting. The installation took about 30 to 40 minutes, and the technician was incredibly kind! They even brought a cloth to lay down to protect the floor during installation and cleaned up the remaining boxes to take away. Control Panel. The buttons are really intuitive, so you can operate it immediately without even reading the manual. It has Power, Start, Course, Lock, Automatic Door Opening, and Remaining Time. The courses are also simple, with only four options. Sterilization Drying (Used to sterilize and dry items containing baby bottles with high-temperature water; no detergent is required). Low Temperature 60°C (For dishes that may deform during high-temperature washing). Powerful 75°C (For washing heavily soiled dishes). Standard 75°C (For washing general, lightly soiled dishes). On the far right, there is a remaining time display and a circular light; a red light indicates the temperature is above 60°C, and a blue light indicates it is below 60°C. Personally, I think a Quick Mode would be great! So you can quickly rinse things like glass cups. Automatic Door Opening. This feature is truly essential! If you leave items full of water without opening the door, they develop a distinctive musty smell. The door opens automatically when there are about 3 minutes left to dry, letting the water drain out completely, so you just need to open the door, dry, and tidy up—that's it! I actually thought the door would open wide since it said "open," but as shown in the attached photo, it only opens a little. Drain Hose. Since this product sits on the countertop, the drain hose is connected inside the sink using suction cups. It is unavoidable since it isn't installed like a built-in unit, but while it doesn't bother me much, it is something to keep in mind. It comes with a 2-year free warranty from Coupang. I was worried because I had never heard of the Midea brand before, but knowing that Coupang offers a 2-year free warranty, I think I can buy it with confidence. After using the dishwasher every day for a week since installation, I don't know how I lived without it until now. My kitchen is quite small, so placing a large product is burdensome, but I like that this one doesn't take up much space. The design is sleek and pretty, so I am satisfied! Although we are a household of three, my child mainly eats breakfast and dinner alone at home, and I think this is the perfect size to run the dishwasher right after every meal. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

They guaranteed next-day arrival, but the technician called to say that their schedule was backed up so they couldn't work on the scheduled date. I waited one more day, and they installed it right away the next morning. I think it would be better if Coupang had a system that only accepted reservations for the number of installations they could actually install. I ended up staying home for two days just waiting. The installation took about 30 to 40 minutes, and the technician was incredibly kind! They even brought a cloth to lay down to protect the floor during installation and cleaned up the remaining boxes to take away. Control Panel. The buttons are really intuitive, so you can operate it immediately without even reading the manual. It has Power, Start, Course, Lock, Automatic Door Opening, and Remaining Time. The courses are also simple, with only four options. Sterilization Drying (Used to sterilize and dry items containing baby bottles with high-temperature water; no detergent is required). Low Temperature 60°C (For dishes that may deform during high-temperature washing). Powerful 75°C (For washing heavily soiled dishes). Standard 75°C (For washing general, lightly soiled dishes). On the far right, there is a remaining time display and a circular light; a red light indicates the temperature is above 60°C, and a blue light indicates it is below 60°C. Personally, I think a Quick Mode would be great! So you can quickly rinse things like glass cups. Automatic Door Opening. This feature is truly essential! If you leave items full of water without opening the door, they develop a distinctive musty smell. The door opens automatically when there are about 3 minutes left to dry, letting the water drain out completely, so you just need to open the door, dry, and tidy up—that's it! I actually thought the door would open wide since it said "open," but as shown in the attached photo, it only opens a little. Drain Hose. Since this product sits on the countertop, the drain hose is connected inside the sink using suction cups. It is unavoidable since it isn't installed like a built-in unit, but while it doesn't bother me much, it is something to keep in mind. It comes with a 2-year free warranty from Coupang. I was worried because I had never heard of the Midea brand before, but knowing that Coupang offers a 2-year free warranty, I think I can buy it with confidence. After using the dishwasher every day for a week since installation, I don't know how I lived without it until now. My kitchen is quite small, so placing a large product is burdensome, but I like that this one doesn't take up much space. The design is sleek and pretty, so I am satisfied! Although we are a household of three, my child mainly eats breakfast and dinner alone at home, and I think this is the perfect size to run the dishwasher right after every meal. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

They guaranteed next-day arrival, but the technician called to say that their schedule was backed up so they couldn't work on the scheduled date. I waited one more day, and they installed it right away the next morning. I think it would be better if Coupang had a system that only accepted reservations for the number of installations they could actually install. I ended up staying home for two days just waiting. The installation took about 30 to 40 minutes, and the technician was incredibly kind! They even brought a cloth to lay down to protect the floor during installation and cleaned up the remaining boxes to take away. Control Panel. The buttons are really intuitive, so you can operate it immediately without even reading the manual. It has Power, Start, Course, Lock, Automatic Door Opening, and Remaining Time. The courses are also simple, with only four options. Sterilization Drying (Used to sterilize and dry items containing baby bottles with high-temperature water; no detergent is required). Low Temperature 60°C (For dishes that may deform during high-temperature washing). Powerful 75°C (For washing heavily soiled dishes). Standard 75°C (For washing general, lightly soiled dishes). On the far right, there is a remaining time display and a circular light; a red light indicates the temperature is above 60°C, and a blue light indicates it is below 60°C. Personally, I think a Quick Mode would be great! So you can quickly rinse things like glass cups. Automatic Door Opening. This feature is truly essential! If you leave items full of water without opening the door, they develop a distinctive musty smell. The door opens automatically when there are about 3 minutes left to dry, letting the water drain out completely, so you just need to open the door, dry, and tidy up—that's it! I actually thought the door would open wide since it said "open," but as shown in the attached photo, it only opens a little. Drain Hose. Since this product sits on the countertop, the drain hose is connected inside the sink using suction cups. It is unavoidable since it isn't installed like a built-in unit, but while it doesn't bother me much, it is something to keep in mind. It comes with a 2-year free warranty from Coupang. I was worried because I had never heard of the Midea brand before, but knowing that Coupang offers a 2-year free warranty, I think I can buy it with confidence. After using the dishwasher every day for a week since installation, I don't know how I lived without it until now. My kitchen is quite small, so placing a large product is burdensome, but I like that this one doesn't take up much space. The design is sleek and pretty, so I am satisfied! Although we are a household of three, my child mainly eats breakfast and dinner alone at home, and I think this is the perfect size to run the dishwasher right after every meal. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Essential Appliances! A Vertical Improvement in Quality of Life ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher lady finally arrived! My friends told me how great it was and insisted I buy one, but since I don't eat at home often, I felt like the cost of water, electricity, and detergent was a waste, so I just thought I'd wash dishes as usual. The 6-place setting is just the right size, making it perfect for a 3-person household like ours—really! Installation. They guaranteed next-day arrival, but the technician called to say that their schedule was backed up so they couldn't work on the scheduled date. I waited one more day, and they installed it right away the next morning. I think it would be better if Coupang had a system that only accepted reservations for the number of installations they could actually install. I ended up staying home for two days just waiting. The installation took about 30 to 40 minutes, and the technician was incredibly kind! They even brought a cloth to lay down to protect the floor during installation and cleaned up the remaining boxes to take away. Control Panel. The buttons are really intuitive, so you can operate it immediately without even reading the manual. It has Power, Start, Course, Lock, Automatic Door Opening, and Remaining Time. The courses are also simple, with only four options. Sterilization Drying (Used to sterilize and dry items containing baby bottles with high-temperature water; no detergent is required). Low Temperature 60°C (For dishes that may deform during high-temperature washing). Powerful 75°C (For washing heavily soiled dishes). Standard 75°C (For washing general, lightly soiled dishes). On the far right, there is a remaining time display and a circular light; a red light indicates the temperature is above 60°C, and a blue light indicates it is below 60°C. Personally, I think a Quick Mode would be great! So you can quickly rinse things like glass cups. Automatic Door Opening. This feature is truly essential! If you leave items full of water without opening the door, they develop a distinctive musty smell. The door opens automatically when there are about 3 minutes left to dry, letting the water drain out completely, so you just need to open the door, dry, and tidy up—that's it! I actually thought the door would open wide since it said "open," but as shown in the attached photo, it only opens a little. Drain Hose. Since this product sits on the countertop, the drain hose is connected inside the sink using suction cups. It is unavoidable since it isn't installed like a built-in unit, but while it doesn't bother me much, it is something to keep in mind. It comes with a 2-year free warranty from Coupang. I was worried because I had never heard of the Midea brand before, but knowing that Coupang offers a 2-year free warranty, I think I can buy it with confidence. After using the dishwasher every day for a week since installation, I don't know how I lived without it until now. My kitchen is quite small, so placing a large product is burdensome, but I like that this one doesn't take up much space. The design is sleek and pretty, so I am satisfied! Although we are a household of three, my child mainly eats breakfast and dinner alone at home, and I think this is the perfect size to run the dishwasher right after every meal. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

The installation took about 30 to 40 minutes, and the technician was incredibly kind! The buttons are really intuitive, so you can operate it immediately without even reading the manual. It has Power, Start, Course, Lock, Automatic Door Opening, and Remaining Time. The courses are also simple, with only four options. Sterilization Drying (Used to sterilize and dry items containing baby bottles with high-temperature water; no detergent is required). Low Temperature 60°C (For dishes that may deform during high-temperature washing). Powerful 75°C (For washing heavily soiled dishes). Standard 75°C (For washing general, lightly soiled dishes). On the far right, there is a remaining time display and a circular light; a red light indicates the temperature is above 60°C, and a blue light indicates it is below 60°C. Personally, I think a Quick Mode would be great! So you can quickly rinse things like glass cups. Automatic Door Opening. This feature is truly essential! If you leave items full of water without opening the door, they develop a distinctive musty smell. The door opens automatically when there are about 3 minutes left to dry, letting the water drain out completely, so you just need to open the door, dry, and tidy up—that's it! I actually thought the door would open wide since it said "open," but as shown in the attached photo, it only opens a little. Drain Hose. Since this product sits on the countertop, the drain hose is connected inside the sink using suction cups. Although we are a household of three, my child mainly eats breakfast and dinner alone at home, and I think this is the perfect size to run the dishwasher right after every meal. Comments (English): [ Essential Appliances! A Vertical Improvement in Quality of Life ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher lady finally arrived! My friends told me how great it was and insisted I buy one, but since I don't eat at home often, I felt like the cost of water, electricity, and detergent was a waste, so I just thought I'd wash dishes as usual. The 6-place setting is just the right size, making it perfect for a 3-person household like ours—really! Installation. They guaranteed next-day arrival, but the technician called to say that their schedule was backed up so they couldn't work on the scheduled date. I waited one more day, and they installed it right away the next morning. I think it would be better if Coupang had a system that only accepted reservations for the number of installations they could actually install. I ended up staying home for two days just waiting. The installation took about 30 to 40 minutes, and the technician was incredibly kind! They even brought a cloth to lay down to protect the floor during installation and cleaned up the remaining boxes to take away. Control Panel. The buttons are really intuitive, so you can operate it immediately without even reading the manual. It has Power, Start, Course, Lock, Automatic Door Opening, and Remaining Time. The courses are also simple, with only four options. Sterilization Drying (Used to sterilize and dry items containing baby bottles with high-temperature water; no detergent is required). Low Temperature 60°C (For dishes that may deform during high-temperature washing). Powerful 75°C (For washing heavily soiled dishes). Standard 75°C (For washing general, lightly soiled dishes). On the far right, there is a remaining time display and a circular light; a red light indicates the temperature is above 60°C, and a blue light indicates it is below 60°C. Personally, I think a Quick Mode would be great! So you can quickly rinse things like glass cups. Automatic Door Opening. This feature is truly essential! If you leave items full of water without opening the door, they develop a distinctive musty smell. The door opens automatically when there are about 3 minutes left to dry, letting the water drain out completely, so you just need to open the door, dry, and tidy up—that's it! I actually thought the door would open wide since it said "open," but as shown in the attached photo, it only opens a little. Drain Hose. Since this product sits on the countertop, the drain hose is connected inside the sink using suction cups. It is unavoidable since it isn't installed like a built-in unit, but while it doesn't bother me much, it is something to keep in mind. It comes with a 2-year free warranty from Coupang. I was worried because I had never heard of the Midea brand before, but knowing that Coupang offers a 2-year free warranty, I think I can buy it with confidence. After using the dishwasher every day for a week since installation, I don't know how I lived without it until now. My kitchen is quite small, so placing a large product is burdensome, but I like that this one doesn't take up much space. The design is sleek and pretty, so I am satisfied! Although we are a household of three, my child mainly eats breakfast and dinner alone at home, and I think this is the perfect size to run the dishwasher right after every meal. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Hello, today I'm going to write a review of the Media 6-person automatic door-opening dishwasher.
Comments (English): Hello, today I'm going to write a review of the Media 6-person automatic door-opening dishwasher. I'm a three-person household with a five-year-old child. We previously used a six-person dishwasher for about five years, but this time I tried the Media dishwasher. The color is white and it's so pretty and shiny. First of all, the design is clean and the white color brightens our kitchen. It has two floors, so it's more than enough for a three-person household like ours. The dishwasher I used before had a door that closed by pressing up and down at the same time, so I always had to use both hands to close it. But with the Media product, I can easily open and close it with one hand. This may not seem like a big deal, but it's incredibly convenient. My kitchen is a bit small, but the dishwasher is slim, so I can leave the door wide open, which is great for space utilization. And what I'm most satisfied with is the cleaning power. I use it in the most basic mode, and it runs on a 65-minute cycle. The washing blades clean the upper, middle, and lower three areas, so it cleans very well. My child's plate is also cleaned. There are a lot of curves, but it was very clean and squeaky clean. When the dishwasher is finished washing, the door opens automatically, and I let it cool down and then let the dishes dry naturally. Since it was washed with very hot water, it dries faster than I thought just by leaving the door open. Since I have a child, I love that I can put the dishes in the dishwasher and play with him during that time. This dishwasher is satisfactory in both design and cleaning power. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Hello, today I’m going to write a product review for the Midea 6-place setting automatic door dishwasher.
Comments (English): Hello, today I’m going to write a product review for the Midea 6-place setting automatic door dishwasher. I am part of a three-person household raising a five-year-old child. I previously used a 6-place setting dishwasher for about five years, but this time I had the opportunity to try the Midea dishwasher. The color is white, and it looks so shiny and pretty. First of all, the design is clean, and because it is white, it makes our kitchen look bright and cheerful. Since it is a two-tier model, it is really sufficient for a three-person household like ours. The dishwasher I used before required pressing the door up and down simultaneously to close, so I always had to use two hands to close it, but with the Midea product, you can easily open and close it with just one hand. It might seem like a small thing, but it is incredibly convenient. Our kitchen is on the smaller side, but because the dishwasher is slim, it makes good use of space—enough to leave the door wide open. And the part I was most satisfied with was the cleaning power. I am using the most basic mode, and it is currently running on a 65-minute cycle. Perhaps because the washing blades clean in three places—top, middle, and bottom—it cleans incredibly well. Even my child's plate, which has many curves, came out squeaky clean. Once the dishwasher finishes, the door opens automatically, and I let the dishes air dry after letting them cool down a bit. Since the water is very hot, they dry surprisingly quickly just by leaving the door open. Having a child, I love putting the dishes in the dishwasher and playing with them during that time. It is a dishwasher that satisfies both design and cleaning power. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through a Coupang Experience Group event.

First of all, since I had previously used a similar 6-place setting model from another brand, I was able to compare them more easily. 1. Size. I think most people who buy this product use it in small kitchens or are looking for a slim one because a large dishwasher is too bulky. I also have a cramped space where I plan to use the dishwasher, so I was looking for a product that fit perfectly, and this was the only option. When I actually received it, the size I wanted was exactly right! It’s not bulky and feels slim, which I love. 2. Design. But you can't just buy something because the size fits, right? It comes in three pastel tones that aren't too flashy. The design is also very pretty and clean, so no matter where I place it in the kitchen, it doesn't detract from the interior, which I really liked. 3. Cleaning Power. We are a family of four, and we tend to produce a lot of side plates, rice bowls, and soup bowls at a time. Except for dishes that cannot be dishwasher-safe, I put everything in and run it on the standard wash cycle. I mainly use powder detergent. Basically, I usually soak the items in water and rinse them once before putting them in. However, areas that inevitably overlap and grease on plastics don't clean as well when placed on the top rack compared to the bottom. It is best to place dishes that require intensive cleaning on the bottom rack. 4. Operation. Sentence (English): I've been using a dishwasher for about 5 years.
Comments (English): I've been using a dishwasher for about 5 years. My SK dishwasher broke down, so I bought this one this time. The brand is Samsung. It says it's a Bespoke countertop style, 6-place setting. They say "countertop" means it sits on top of the kitchen sink. I haven't used a built-in model; I've only used this style. Most built-in models are 12-place settings. Due to the nature of dishwashers, the drainage system tends to break down after more than a year of use. A repair technician told me before that it breaks down because food scraps, grease, or detergent residue clog the drain. I always pre-wash dishes, but even so, water leaks still occur after about a year. Since this happens to some extent, it's good for those who haven't used one to keep in mind. SK dishwasher service is generally good, and the technician in my neighborhood was kind, so I think Samsung will be fine as well. First of all, the design is very simple, and the controls are simple and intuitive. It is easy enough for even elderly people to handle. They recommended solid or powder detergent over liquid. I used to use powder, but I spilled it frequently, so now I use solid detergent. These days, many solid detergents come in small sizes, so you can use them without having to divide them up. It cleans well. I mostly use LG Electronics products, but LG dishwashers are a bit expensive. So I just bought this one. I replace mine every five years anyway. I usually end up replacing them due to limescale or breakdowns. Since I tend to buy cheap ones and replace them frequently, I prioritize price. However, there are people who buy and use their products for a long time, so please take my review with a grain of salt, as it is just my personal opinion. Overall: The design is clean. It has a single-stage design, is deep, and is larger than expected (my previous SK model was two-stage). Based on my experience, I think the single stage is better! The intuitive controls are convenient. It is quieter than the one I used before.

Could use a cycle time display. ] || ---------------- || I never thought I'd get excited about a dishwasher, but here I am! This dishwasher genuinely feels like a luxury. The first thing that stood out to me was how incredibly quiet it is. It's so quiet that I've found myself checking to make sure it's actually running. My husband, who's a light sleeper, used to wake up every time our old dishwasher was on, so we noticed the difference immediately. When it comes to cleaning power, I was skeptical at first, but I'm honestly amazed. It cleaned a severely burnt pot with barely any scrubbing needed on my part. I'm attaching before-and-after pictures of the pot to show just how well it worked! I don't even bother pre-rinsing anymore—plates, pots, glasses, cutlery, and even my skincare tools all come out spotless, like they've been hand-washed by a meticulous little elf. I also have to mention the adjustable racks, which move smoothly with just a simple button on the sides. I can easily shift the middle rack up or down depending on what I need to load, and this flexibility has been a game-changer for fitting in oversized mugs and awkwardly shaped pans. The racks glide in and out effortlessly, and the dishwasher feels incredibly spacious thanks to its third top rack and removable cutlery basket. I also love that the interior is stainless steel, giving it a sleek, polished look (I've attached pictures and a video). The exterior is fingerprint and water spot resistant, which is great for keeping it looking clean. The buttons are soft, sensitive to touch, and respond instantly. The only thing I'd change is the lack of a display showing the remaining time for the cycle to finish. A small screen for that would be really useful. But aside from that minor issue, everything about this dishwasher is absolutely perfect!

Comments (English): [ Bosch 800 Series ] || ---------------- || The Bosch 800 series with Crystal Dry setting does an excellent job cleaning and drying dishes. I put the lids to my plastic containers in the top skinny rack and some of the flatware which is new to me. I downloaded the Bosch app and learned how to start my dishwasher remotely but I don't use it very often to start remotely. I do like that the app lets me know when the cleaning cycle is completed. I also like the helpful videos on the app which showed me how to raise the racks. I bought a magnet to stick on outside to let everyone in the household to know if dishes are "CLEAN" or "DIRTY" so they know if they need to unload it. It would be helpful for Bosch to have it easier to identify if dishes are finished running through the cycle upon completion from the outside of the dishwasher and not just the app. This dishwasher is so quiet that I have to put my ear up close to make sure I turned it on correctly.

I'm satisfied because it matches well with my existing sink and other appliances. I was going to buy a 12-person one, but since everyone says the bigger the dishwasher, the better, I bought a 14-person one, and I don't regret it. There's so much storage space that I don't even have to play Tetris when putting dishes in. When I don't have much to wash, I use the top speed mode and it takes about 30 minutes, so I use it often! Sentence (English): The space is small, so I chose an 8-person one.
Comments (English): [ Having a dishwasher saves time. ] || ---------------- || The space is small, so I chose an 8-person one. It's a good size for a family of 4 to eat one meal and do the laundry. Since it's a non-standard cabinet, an additional remodeling fee was charged. When I first moved in, I applied for a 12-person dishwasher, but they said they had to do the entire thing, from the seasoning container with rails to the sink, so I just said I wouldn't install it. Sentence (English): We've only been operating the unit for about a week.
Comments (English): [ Very Quiet ] || ---------------- || We've only been operating the unit for about a week. It's very quiet and has been cleaning the dishes satisfactorily so far. The install is pretty straight forward if you are handy, although the diagrams and sketches in the documentation leave something to be desired. The unit is wrapped in insulation which is only loosely secured to the frame.The insulation makes for a very tight fit in the standard 24" opening. I suppose you could remove it, but that would impair the noise reduction it provides. The tub is large, but there are no fold down tines in the racks which is odd for a machine of this quality. Operating instructions are somewhat cryptic. I emailed Kitchen Aid support with a question and they never responded. There is a "second level" dishwasher setting menu which apparently allows you to make adjustments to basic settings like menu sounds and rinse quantity. But the manual does not explain if it actually applies to this model, and deciphering how to adjust the settings is like cracking a coded message embedded in a tic-tac-toe board. I haven't tried it yet. One thing that's bugged me about dishwashers is the door. Why can't they make one with a damped door which gently falls open after it's unlatched instead of having to bend and push it down every time you open it? Oh well, maybe I just purchase the calisthenics models. Our last unit was a Bosch which leaked after 8 years. When I tried to repair it, I found that some repair techs would not even service a Bosch, and the parts cost almost as much as the machine. So now, I bought American. Pardon me if I sound a little negative, I'm not. This appears to be a very good machine. We'll see.

Comments (English): [ Really? You must be joking! ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) When I buy an automatic dishwasher, I expect it to complete without human intervention. I purchased this model a couple of months ago and every time I unload it, the dishes are damp. Some dishes have come out sticky and required a re-wash. I followed the user's manual to the letter. Fill and program for rinse aid - done. Fill and program salt - done. Avoid liquid detergent - check. Load it so no water can pool - as best I can. I followed the advice from Bosch to set the machine to Auto and extra dry. The dishes still come out damp. Oddly enough, Bosch also suggest that I open the dishwasher as soon as it's done so that the moisture can escape. Really? It's an automatic dishwasher, it should not require any human intervention to complete its job. I expect my dishes to be bone dry when I empty it. I expect the interior of the unit to have no water/condensation left in it. Otherwise it is a recipe for mold growth. Bosch was highly recommended by family and friends, and it carries a very high reputation. I am beyond disappointed and dismayed at this diswasher's poor performance. At its price point I would expect a much better performance. It is preposterous such a highly rated machine can't do the job properly. I DO NOT recommend it.

Sentence (English): I had a dishwasher that I used at my parents’ house for a long time, but it was so old that I was thinking about replacing it.
Comments (English): [ It makes good use of space in a small kitchen and cleans well. ] || ---------------- || I had a dishwasher that I used at my parents’ house for a long time, but it was so old that I was thinking about replacing it. This was a good opportunity to buy a new 6-person Media automatic door opening dishwasher. My kitchen is small, so buying a new appliance was always a burden, but the Media dishwasher is advantageous in terms of space utilization. My parents’ house already had a dishwasher, so I didn’t have to do any additional drilling, but the drilling size is very small at 10mm, so it is easy to install, so even if I had to drill a new hole, it would have been less of a burden. The Media dishwasher is a 6-person unit, but it doesn’t take up as much space as I thought, so it goes well in a small kitchen. The part that I liked the most after installation is the 3-stage washing system: top, middle, and bottom. The top washing blade located on the ceiling rotates and sprays water to clean the upper dishes, and the middle blade is attached to the wall to thoroughly wash between the dishes. The bottom has a dual washing blade, so you can clean the large dishes in the bottom tray. Thanks to this, sauces and grease are removed cleanly. The most useful feature of the dishwasher is the automatic door opening function. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly discharge the hot, humid air and the outside wind naturally dries the dishes. Thanks to this function, you don’t have to worry about moisture or odor after washing. And I chose a pastel-toned, soft blue color for this product, which makes the kitchen look neater and more sophisticated. There are also a variety of colors to choose from, so you can choose one that matches your interior. However, I felt that there was a little less storage space than the dishwasher I used before. Maybe it’s because I’m not used to using it yet, but I think there isn’t as much storage as I thought. But since it’s just my parents, it’s not a big problem. Small bowls and seasoning bowls can be placed in the upper basket, and pots and plates can be placed in the lower basket, so it’s used efficiently. It’s also convenient because I can wash the dishes right away after eating instead of having to collect them. In the past, when there were few dishes, I often ended up washing them by hand because it was burdensome to run the dishwasher, but now I can use even a small amount of dishes without any burden. At first, I was worried because the media brand was unfamiliar, but after looking into it, I found out that it was a well-known large company in China, and that Coupang even provided a 2-year free A/S warranty, so I was reassured. I like the product because it has a convenient automatic door opening function after washing, and it fits well in narrow spaces. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): My kitchen is small, so buying a new appliance was always a burden, but the Media dishwasher is advantageous in terms of space utilization.
Comments (English): [ It makes good use of space in a small kitchen and cleans well. ] || ---------------- || I had a dishwasher that I used at my parents’ house for a long time, but it was so old that I was thinking about replacing it. This was a good opportunity to buy a new 6-person Media automatic door opening dishwasher. My kitchen is small, so buying a new appliance was always a burden, but the Media dishwasher is advantageous in terms of space utilization. My parents’ house already had a dishwasher, so I didn’t have to do any additional drilling, but the drilling size is very small at 10mm, so it is easy to install, so even if I had to drill a new hole, it would have been less of a burden. The Media dishwasher is a 6-person unit, but it doesn’t take up as much space as I thought, so it goes well in a small kitchen. The part that I liked the most after installation is the 3-stage washing system: top, middle, and bottom. The top washing blade located on the ceiling rotates and sprays water to clean the upper dishes, and the middle blade is attached to the wall to thoroughly wash between the dishes. The bottom has a dual washing blade, so you can clean the large dishes in the bottom tray. Thanks to this, sauces and grease are removed cleanly. The most useful feature of the dishwasher is the automatic door opening function. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly discharge the hot, humid air and the outside wind naturally dries the dishes. Thanks to this function, you don’t have to worry about moisture or odor after washing. And I chose a pastel-toned, soft blue color for this product, which makes the kitchen look neater and more sophisticated. There are also a variety of colors to choose from, so you can choose one that matches your interior. However, I felt that there was a little less storage space than the dishwasher I used before. Maybe it’s because I’m not used to using it yet, but I think there isn’t as much storage as I thought. But since it’s just my parents, it’s not a big problem. Small bowls and seasoning bowls can be placed in the upper basket, and pots and plates can be placed in the lower basket, so it’s used efficiently. It’s also convenient because I can wash the dishes right away after eating instead of having to collect them. In the past, when there were few dishes, I often ended up washing them by hand because it was burdensome to run the dishwasher, but now I can use even a small amount of dishes without any burden. At first, I was worried because the media brand was unfamiliar, but after looking into it, I found out that it was a well-known large company in China, and that Coupang even provided a 2-year free A/S warranty, so I was reassured. I like the product because it has a convenient automatic door opening function after washing, and it fits well in narrow spaces. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): In the past, when there were few dishes, I often ended up washing them by hand because it was burdensome to run the dishwasher, but now I can use even a small amount of dishes without any burden.
Comments (English): [ It makes good use of space in a small kitchen and cleans well. ] || ---------------- || I had a dishwasher that I used at my parents’ house for a long time, but it was so old that I was thinking about replacing it. This was a good opportunity to buy a new 6-person Media automatic door opening dishwasher. My kitchen is small, so buying a new appliance was always a burden, but the Media dishwasher is advantageous in terms of space utilization. My parents’ house already had a dishwasher, so I didn’t have to do any additional drilling, but the drilling size is very small at 10mm, so it is easy to install, so even if I had to drill a new hole, it would have been less of a burden. The Media dishwasher is a 6-person unit, but it doesn’t take up as much space as I thought, so it goes well in a small kitchen. The part that I liked the most after installation is the 3-stage washing system: top, middle, and bottom. The top washing blade located on the ceiling rotates and sprays water to clean the upper dishes, and the middle blade is attached to the wall to thoroughly wash between the dishes. The bottom has a dual washing blade, so you can clean the large dishes in the bottom tray. Thanks to this, sauces and grease are removed cleanly. The most useful feature of the dishwasher is the automatic door opening function. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly discharge the hot, humid air and the outside wind naturally dries the dishes. Thanks to this function, you don’t have to worry about moisture or odor after washing. And I chose a pastel-toned, soft blue color for this product, which makes the kitchen look neater and more sophisticated. There are also a variety of colors to choose from, so you can choose one that matches your interior. However, I felt that there was a little less storage space than the dishwasher I used before. Maybe it’s because I’m not used to using it yet, but I think there isn’t as much storage as I thought. But since it’s just my parents, it’s not a big problem. Small bowls and seasoning bowls can be placed in the upper basket, and pots and plates can be placed in the lower basket, so it’s used efficiently. It’s also convenient because I can wash the dishes right away after eating instead of having to collect them. In the past, when there were few dishes, I often ended up washing them by hand because it was burdensome to run the dishwasher, but now I can use even a small amount of dishes without any burden. At first, I was worried because the media brand was unfamiliar, but after looking into it, I found out that it was a well-known large company in China, and that Coupang even provided a 2-year free A/S warranty, so I was reassured. I like the product because it has a convenient automatic door opening function after washing, and it fits well in narrow spaces. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): My parents had a dishwasher that had been in use for a long time, but it was so old that I was considering replacing it.
Comments (English): [ It's great for utilizing space in a small kitchen and is easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || My parents had a dishwasher that had been in use for a long time, but it was so old that I was considering replacing it. Luckily, I got a new 6-seater Media Auto-Open Dishwasher. My kitchen is small, so adding new appliances was always a challenge, but the Media dishwasher is a great way to maximize space. Since my parents already had a dishwasher, I didn't have to drill any additional holes. However, the 10mm hole size is very small, making installation easier. Even if I had needed to drill new holes, it wouldn't have been a problem. Despite being a 6-seater, the Media dishwasher doesn't take up as much space as I thought, making it a great fit in my small kitchen. My favorite part about the unit is its three-stage wash system: top, middle, and bottom. The top washing blades, located on the ceiling, rotate and spray water to thoroughly clean the dishes above. The middle blades, mounted on the wall, thoroughly clean between dishes. The bottom has dual washing blades, allowing me to thoroughly wash even the larger dishes in the lower tray. Thanks to this, sauces and grease are thoroughly removed. The most useful feature of the dishwasher is the auto door open function. After washing, the door automatically opens, quickly releasing hot, humid air and allowing the outside air to naturally dry the dishes. Thanks to this function, I don't have to worry about moisture or odors after washing. I chose this product in a soft, pastel blue color, which makes the kitchen look neat and sophisticated. I also like that the variety of colors allows me to choose the one that best suits my interior. However, I felt like there was a little less storage space than with my previous dishwasher. Maybe it's because I'm still not used to using it, but it feels like there's not as much storage as I thought. However, since it's just my parents, it's not a big problem. Small dishes and seasoning bowls can be stored in the upper basket, while pots and plates are stored in the lower basket, making it efficient. It's also convenient to be able to wash dishes immediately after meals instead of having to pile them up. Before, when I had a small load of dishes, I often ended up washing them by hand because it was burdensome to run the dishwasher. Now, even small loads can be handled without any hassle. At first, I was worried because the media brand was unfamiliar, but after researching, I learned it was a well-known major company in China and that Coupang even offered a two-year free after-sales service warranty, which put me at ease. I love the automatic door-opening feature after washing, which makes it convenient to use and makes it perfect for tight spaces. This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
