Sentence (English): Since my parents already had a dishwasher, I didn't have to drill any additional holes.
Comments (English): [ It's great for utilizing space in a small kitchen and is easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || My parents had a dishwasher that had been in use for a long time, but it was so old that I was considering replacing it. Luckily, I got a new 6-seater Media Auto-Open Dishwasher. My kitchen is small, so adding new appliances was always a challenge, but the Media dishwasher is a great way to maximize space. Since my parents already had a dishwasher, I didn't have to drill any additional holes. However, the 10mm hole size is very small, making installation easier. Even if I had needed to drill new holes, it wouldn't have been a problem. Despite being a 6-seater, the Media dishwasher doesn't take up as much space as I thought, making it a great fit in my small kitchen. My favorite part about the unit is its three-stage wash system: top, middle, and bottom. The top washing blades, located on the ceiling, rotate and spray water to thoroughly clean the dishes above. The middle blades, mounted on the wall, thoroughly clean between dishes. The bottom has dual washing blades, allowing me to thoroughly wash even the larger dishes in the lower tray. Thanks to this, sauces and grease are thoroughly removed. The most useful feature of the dishwasher is the auto door open function. After washing, the door automatically opens, quickly releasing hot, humid air and allowing the outside air to naturally dry the dishes. Thanks to this function, I don't have to worry about moisture or odors after washing. I chose this product in a soft, pastel blue color, which makes the kitchen look neat and sophisticated. I also like that the variety of colors allows me to choose the one that best suits my interior. However, I felt like there was a little less storage space than with my previous dishwasher. Maybe it's because I'm still not used to using it, but it feels like there's not as much storage as I thought. However, since it's just my parents, it's not a big problem. Small dishes and seasoning bowls can be stored in the upper basket, while pots and plates are stored in the lower basket, making it efficient. It's also convenient to be able to wash dishes immediately after meals instead of having to pile them up. Before, when I had a small load of dishes, I often ended up washing them by hand because it was burdensome to run the dishwasher. Now, even small loads can be handled without any hassle. At first, I was worried because the media brand was unfamiliar, but after researching, I learned it was a well-known major company in China and that Coupang even offered a two-year free after-sales service warranty, which put me at ease. I love the automatic door-opening feature after washing, which makes it convenient to use and makes it perfect for tight spaces. This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Despite being a 6-seater, the Media dishwasher doesn't take up as much space as I thought, making it a great fit in my small kitchen.
Comments (English): [ It's great for utilizing space in a small kitchen and is easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || My parents had a dishwasher that had been in use for a long time, but it was so old that I was considering replacing it. Luckily, I got a new 6-seater Media Auto-Open Dishwasher. My kitchen is small, so adding new appliances was always a challenge, but the Media dishwasher is a great way to maximize space. Since my parents already had a dishwasher, I didn't have to drill any additional holes. However, the 10mm hole size is very small, making installation easier. Even if I had needed to drill new holes, it wouldn't have been a problem. Despite being a 6-seater, the Media dishwasher doesn't take up as much space as I thought, making it a great fit in my small kitchen. My favorite part about the unit is its three-stage wash system: top, middle, and bottom. The top washing blades, located on the ceiling, rotate and spray water to thoroughly clean the dishes above. The middle blades, mounted on the wall, thoroughly clean between dishes. The bottom has dual washing blades, allowing me to thoroughly wash even the larger dishes in the lower tray. Thanks to this, sauces and grease are thoroughly removed. The most useful feature of the dishwasher is the auto door open function. After washing, the door automatically opens, quickly releasing hot, humid air and allowing the outside air to naturally dry the dishes. Thanks to this function, I don't have to worry about moisture or odors after washing. I chose this product in a soft, pastel blue color, which makes the kitchen look neat and sophisticated. I also like that the variety of colors allows me to choose the one that best suits my interior. However, I felt like there was a little less storage space than with my previous dishwasher. Maybe it's because I'm still not used to using it, but it feels like there's not as much storage as I thought. However, since it's just my parents, it's not a big problem. Small dishes and seasoning bowls can be stored in the upper basket, while pots and plates are stored in the lower basket, making it efficient. It's also convenient to be able to wash dishes immediately after meals instead of having to pile them up. Before, when I had a small load of dishes, I often ended up washing them by hand because it was burdensome to run the dishwasher. Now, even small loads can be handled without any hassle. At first, I was worried because the media brand was unfamiliar, but after researching, I learned it was a well-known major company in China and that Coupang even offered a two-year free after-sales service warranty, which put me at ease. I love the automatic door-opening feature after washing, which makes it convenient to use and makes it perfect for tight spaces. This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ It's great for utilizing space in a small kitchen and is easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || My parents had a dishwasher that had been in use for a long time, but it was so old that I was considering replacing it. Since my parents already had a dishwasher, I didn't have to drill any additional holes. However, the 10mm hole size is very small, making installation easier. Even if I had needed to drill new holes, it wouldn't have been a problem. Despite being a 6-seater, the Media dishwasher doesn't take up as much space as I thought, making it a great fit in my small kitchen. My favorite part about the unit is its three-stage wash system: top, middle, and bottom. The top washing blades, located on the ceiling, rotate and spray water to thoroughly clean the dishes above. The middle blades, mounted on the wall, thoroughly clean between dishes. The bottom has dual washing blades, allowing me to thoroughly wash even the larger dishes in the lower tray. Thanks to this, sauces and grease are thoroughly removed. The most useful feature of the dishwasher is the auto door open function. After washing, the door automatically opens, quickly releasing hot, humid air and allowing the outside air to naturally dry the dishes. Thanks to this function, I don't have to worry about moisture or odors after washing. I chose this product in a soft, pastel blue color, which makes the kitchen look neat and sophisticated. I also like that the variety of colors allows me to choose the one that best suits my interior. However, I felt like there was a little less storage space than with my previous dishwasher. Maybe it's because I'm still not used to using it, but it feels like there's not as much storage as I thought. However, since it's just my parents, it's not a big problem. It's also convenient to be able to wash dishes immediately after meals instead of having to pile them up. This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ It's great for utilizing space in a small kitchen and is easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || My parents had a dishwasher that had been in use for a long time, but it was so old that I was considering replacing it. Luckily, I got a new 6-seater Media Auto-Open Dishwasher. My kitchen is small, so adding new appliances was always a challenge, but the Media dishwasher is a great way to maximize space. Since my parents already had a dishwasher, I didn't have to drill any additional holes. However, the 10mm hole size is very small, making installation easier. Even if I had needed to drill new holes, it wouldn't have been a problem. Despite being a 6-seater, the Media dishwasher doesn't take up as much space as I thought, making it a great fit in my small kitchen. My favorite part about the unit is its three-stage wash system: top, middle, and bottom. The top washing blades, located on the ceiling, rotate and spray water to thoroughly clean the dishes above. The middle blades, mounted on the wall, thoroughly clean between dishes. The bottom has dual washing blades, allowing me to thoroughly wash even the larger dishes in the lower tray. Thanks to this, sauces and grease are thoroughly removed. The most useful feature of the dishwasher is the auto door open function. After washing, the door automatically opens, quickly releasing hot, humid air and allowing the outside air to naturally dry the dishes. Thanks to this function, I don't have to worry about moisture or odors after washing. I chose this product in a soft, pastel blue color, which makes the kitchen look neat and sophisticated. I also like that the variety of colors allows me to choose the one that best suits my interior. However, I felt like there was a little less storage space than with my previous dishwasher. Maybe it's because I'm still not used to using it, but it feels like there's not as much storage as I thought. However, since it's just my parents, it's not a big problem. Small dishes and seasoning bowls can be stored in the upper basket, while pots and plates are stored in the lower basket, making it efficient. It's also convenient to be able to wash dishes immediately after meals instead of having to pile them up. Before, when I had a small load of dishes, I often ended up washing them by hand because it was burdensome to run the dishwasher. Now, even small loads can be handled without any hassle. At first, I was worried because the media brand was unfamiliar, but after researching, I learned it was a well-known major company in China and that Coupang even offered a two-year free after-sales service warranty, which put me at ease. I love the automatic door-opening feature after washing, which makes it convenient to use and makes it perfect for tight spaces. This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ It's great for utilizing space in a small kitchen and is easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || My parents had a dishwasher that had been in use for a long time, but it was so old that I was considering replacing it. Since my parents already had a dishwasher, I didn't have to drill any additional holes. However, the 10mm hole size is very small, making installation easier. Even if I had needed to drill new holes, it wouldn't have been a problem. Despite being a 6-seater, the Media dishwasher doesn't take up as much space as I thought, making it a great fit in my small kitchen. My favorite part about the unit is its three-stage wash system: top, middle, and bottom. The top washing blades, located on the ceiling, rotate and spray water to thoroughly clean the dishes above. The middle blades, mounted on the wall, thoroughly clean between dishes. The bottom has dual washing blades, allowing me to thoroughly wash even the larger dishes in the lower tray. Thanks to this, sauces and grease are thoroughly removed. The most useful feature of the dishwasher is the auto door open function. After washing, the door automatically opens, quickly releasing hot, humid air and allowing the outside air to naturally dry the dishes. Thanks to this function, I don't have to worry about moisture or odors after washing. I chose this product in a soft, pastel blue color, which makes the kitchen look neat and sophisticated. I also like that the variety of colors allows me to choose the one that best suits my interior. However, I felt like there was a little less storage space than with my previous dishwasher. Maybe it's because I'm still not used to using it, but it feels like there's not as much storage as I thought. However, since it's just my parents, it's not a big problem. Small dishes and seasoning bowls can be stored in the upper basket, while pots and plates are stored in the lower basket, making it efficient. It's also convenient to be able to wash dishes immediately after meals instead of having to pile them up. This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ It's great for utilizing space in a small kitchen and is easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || My parents had a dishwasher that had been in use for a long time, but it was so old that I was considering replacing it. Since my parents already had a dishwasher, I didn't have to drill any additional holes. However, the 10mm hole size is very small, making installation easier. Even if I had needed to drill new holes, it wouldn't have been a problem. Despite being a 6-seater, the Media dishwasher doesn't take up as much space as I thought, making it a great fit in my small kitchen. My favorite part about the unit is its three-stage wash system: top, middle, and bottom. The top washing blades, located on the ceiling, rotate and spray water to thoroughly clean the dishes above. The middle blades, mounted on the wall, thoroughly clean between dishes. The bottom has dual washing blades, allowing me to thoroughly wash even the larger dishes in the lower tray. Thanks to this, sauces and grease are thoroughly removed. The most useful feature of the dishwasher is the auto door open function. After washing, the door automatically opens, quickly releasing hot, humid air and allowing the outside air to naturally dry the dishes. Thanks to this function, I don't have to worry about moisture or odors after washing. I chose this product in a soft, pastel blue color, which makes the kitchen look neat and sophisticated. I also like that the variety of colors allows me to choose the one that best suits my interior. However, I felt like there was a little less storage space than with my previous dishwasher. Maybe it's because I'm still not used to using it, but it feels like there's not as much storage as I thought. However, since it's just my parents, it's not a big problem. Small dishes and seasoning bowls can be stored in the upper basket, while pots and plates are stored in the lower basket, making it efficient. It's also convenient to be able to wash dishes immediately after meals instead of having to pile them up. This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ It's great for utilizing space in a small kitchen and is easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || My parents had a dishwasher that had been in use for a long time, but it was so old that I was considering replacing it. Luckily, I got a new 6-seater Media Auto-Open Dishwasher. My kitchen is small, so adding new appliances was always a challenge, but the Media dishwasher is a great way to maximize space. Since my parents already had a dishwasher, I didn't have to drill any additional holes. However, the 10mm hole size is very small, making installation easier. Even if I had needed to drill new holes, it wouldn't have been a problem. Despite being a 6-seater, the Media dishwasher doesn't take up as much space as I thought, making it a great fit in my small kitchen. My favorite part about the unit is its three-stage wash system: top, middle, and bottom. The top washing blades, located on the ceiling, rotate and spray water to thoroughly clean the dishes above. The middle blades, mounted on the wall, thoroughly clean between dishes. The bottom has dual washing blades, allowing me to thoroughly wash even the larger dishes in the lower tray. Thanks to this, sauces and grease are thoroughly removed. The most useful feature of the dishwasher is the auto door open function. After washing, the door automatically opens, quickly releasing hot, humid air and allowing the outside air to naturally dry the dishes. Thanks to this function, I don't have to worry about moisture or odors after washing. I chose this product in a soft, pastel blue color, which makes the kitchen look neat and sophisticated. I also like that the variety of colors allows me to choose the one that best suits my interior. However, I felt like there was a little less storage space than with my previous dishwasher. Maybe it's because I'm still not used to using it, but it feels like there's not as much storage as I thought. However, since it's just my parents, it's not a big problem. Small dishes and seasoning bowls can be stored in the upper basket, while pots and plates are stored in the lower basket, making it efficient. It's also convenient to be able to wash dishes immediately after meals instead of having to pile them up. Before, when I had a small load of dishes, I often ended up washing them by hand because it was burdensome to run the dishwasher. Now, even small loads can be handled without any hassle. At first, I was worried because the media brand was unfamiliar, but after researching, I learned it was a well-known major company in China and that Coupang even offered a two-year free after-sales service warranty, which put me at ease. I love the automatic door-opening feature after washing, which makes it convenient to use and makes it perfect for tight spaces. This review was written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): We've only been operating the unit for about a week.
Comments (English): [ Very Quiet ] || ---------------- || We've only been operating the unit for about a week. It's very quiet and has been cleaning the dishes satisfactorily so far. The install is pretty straight forward if you are handy, although the diagrams and sketches in the documentation leave something to be desired. The unit is wrapped in insulation which is only loosely secured to the frame.The insulation makes for a very tight fit in the standard 24\" opening. I suppose you could remove it, but that would impair the noise reduction it provides. The tub is large, but there are no fold down tines in the racks which is odd for a machine of this quality. Operating instructions are somewhat cryptic. I emailed Kitchen Aid support with a question and they never responded. There is a \"second level\" dishwasher setting menu which apparently allows you to make adjustments to basic settings like menu sounds and rinse quantity. But the manual does not explain if it actually applies to this model, and deciphering how to adjust the settings is like cracking a coded message embedded in a tic-tac-toe board. I haven't tried it yet. One thing that's bugged me about dishwashers is the door. Why can't they make one with a damped door which gently falls open after it's unlatched instead of having to bend and push it down every time you open it? Oh well, maybe I just purchase the calisthenics models. Our last unit was a Bosch which leaked after 8 years. When I tried to repair it, I found that some repair techs would not even service a Bosch, and the parts cost almost as much as the machine. So now, I bought American. Pardon me if I sound a little negative, I'm not. This appears to be a very good machine. We'll see.

Sentence (English): We had decided a few years ago that when it came time to replace our dishwasher it would be with a Bosch.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 100 Premium Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We had decided a few years ago that when it came time to replace our dishwasher it would be with a Bosch. This summer that opportunity came up. We had heard that they were quietand reliable, cleaned well and also sometimes difficult to load. The one feature we had decided on was a handle bar door front in white. The only negative I would have is that this door is only available on a couple of models. The 800 was to expensive and the 100 Premium has a hybrid tub. We opted for the 100. I installed the dishwasher and on my first attempt attempt I damaged one of the weatherstrip pieces that is on each side. I ordered a replacement and it arrived quickly and was easy to replace. Do we like it? Yes, Our dishes are cleaner, the machine runs quietly. After learning how to use the different ways to load it, It holds everything and then more than our old dishwasher did. We haven't experienced the "wet" dishes that some complain about when they empty their dishwasher. Would I recommend it? We already have.

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!
