Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

(9번째 사진) 매번 닦아서 집어넣다가 이제는 그냥 문열림 모드로 놔둔 뒤에 다음날 아침에 빼주면 자연건조까지 더해져서 좀더 보송한 건조를 느끼고 있어요.  3. 넣고 빼는게 이렇게 귀찮은 일이였나? 그릇 모양이 일정한 집이라면 우아한 정렬이 가능했겠지만 우리집은 애들 식기도 많고 온갖 크기와 모양의 그릇이 많다보니  이게 좀 까다롭게 느껴지더라구요.  그래도 집어 넣는건 쓸수록 요령이 생기다보니 좀 나아지는것 같아요.  빼는건.. 용병을 구했습니다ㅋㅋ(10번째 사진)  ○5인가족의 사용법 5인 가족이라 평소에도 설거지거리는 넘치는 편이지만 요즘 남편이 식단조절 중이라 아침을 안먹고 나가는 관계로 평일 아침/점심엔 설거지거리가 꽤 없는 편이에요. 일반적인 가정이라면 세끼 설거지거리를 모아서 한번에 돌리는것도 상관 없는 넉넉한 크기의 12인용 식세기지만 설거지거리가 워낙 많은 우리집은 아침/점심 설거지 거리를 맨 아랫칸에 모아서 하단 세척모드로 1회 돌려주고  저녁에 전체 세척으로 1회 더 돌리니까 딱 알맞네요.  ○마무리 평소에 식세기 설치는 일부러 눈에서 띄워놓고 고려도 안하고 있었기에 이상이랑 다르다며 투덜댔지만 제 삶의 질은 확실히 한단계 이상 올라갔어요. 이제 다시는 없던 때로는 돌아갈 수 없을듯...ㅎ 그동안 집안일중에 설거지가 제일 싫다고 이야기 하던 사람으로서 이제는 빨래 접는게 제일 싫다고 자신있게 말할 수 있습니다!ㅋㅋ

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

(9번째 사진) 매번 닦아서 집어넣다가 이제는 그냥 문열림 모드로 놔둔 뒤에 다음날 아침에 빼주면 자연건조까지 더해져서 좀더 보송한 건조를 느끼고 있어요.  3. 넣고 빼는게 이렇게 귀찮은 일이였나? 그릇 모양이 일정한 집이라면 우아한 정렬이 가능했겠지만 우리집은 애들 식기도 많고 온갖 크기와 모양의 그릇이 많다보니  이게 좀 까다롭게 느껴지더라구요.  그래도 집어 넣는건 쓸수록 요령이 생기다보니 좀 나아지는것 같아요.  빼는건.. 용병을 구했습니다ㅋㅋ(10번째 사진)  ○5인가족의 사용법 5인 가족이라 평소에도 설거지거리는 넘치는 편이지만 요즘 남편이 식단조절 중이라 아침을 안먹고 나가는 관계로 평일 아침/점심엔 설거지거리가 꽤 없는 편이에요. 일반적인 가정이라면 세끼 설거지거리를 모아서 한번에 돌리는것도 상관 없는 넉넉한 크기의 12인용 식세기지만 설거지거리가 워낙 많은 우리집은 아침/점심 설거지 거리를 맨 아랫칸에 모아서 하단 세척모드로 1회 돌려주고  저녁에 전체 세척으로 1회 더 돌리니까 딱 알맞네요.  ○마무리 평소에 식세기 설치는 일부러 눈에서 띄워놓고 고려도 안하고 있었기에 이상이랑 다르다며 투덜댔지만 제 삶의 질은 확실히 한단계 이상 올라갔어요. 이제 다시는 없던 때로는 돌아갈 수 없을듯...ㅎ 그동안 집안일중에 설거지가 제일 싫다고 이야기 하던 사람으로서 이제는 빨래 접는게 제일 싫다고 자신있게 말할 수 있습니다!ㅋㅋ

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

(9번째 사진) 매번 닦아서 집어넣다가 이제는 그냥 문열림 모드로 놔둔 뒤에 다음날 아침에 빼주면 자연건조까지 더해져서 좀더 보송한 건조를 느끼고 있어요.  3. 넣고 빼는게 이렇게 귀찮은 일이였나? 그릇 모양이 일정한 집이라면 우아한 정렬이 가능했겠지만 우리집은 애들 식기도 많고 온갖 크기와 모양의 그릇이 많다보니  이게 좀 까다롭게 느껴지더라구요.  그래도 집어 넣는건 쓸수록 요령이 생기다보니 좀 나아지는것 같아요.  빼는건.. 용병을 구했습니다ㅋㅋ(10번째 사진)  ○5인가족의 사용법 5인 가족이라 평소에도 설거지거리는 넘치는 편이지만 요즘 남편이 식단조절 중이라 아침을 안먹고 나가는 관계로 평일 아침/점심엔 설거지거리가 꽤 없는 편이에요. 일반적인 가정이라면 세끼 설거지거리를 모아서 한번에 돌리는것도 상관 없는 넉넉한 크기의 12인용 식세기지만 설거지거리가 워낙 많은 우리집은 아침/점심 설거지 거리를 맨 아랫칸에 모아서 하단 세척모드로 1회 돌려주고  저녁에 전체 세척으로 1회 더 돌리니까 딱 알맞네요.  ○마무리 평소에 식세기 설치는 일부러 눈에서 띄워놓고 고려도 안하고 있었기에 이상이랑 다르다며 투덜댔지만 제 삶의 질은 확실히 한단계 이상 올라갔어요. 이제 다시는 없던 때로는 돌아갈 수 없을듯...ㅎ 그동안 집안일중에 설거지가 제일 싫다고 이야기 하던 사람으로서 이제는 빨래 접는게 제일 싫다고 자신있게 말할 수 있습니다!ㅋㅋ

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

(9번째 사진) 매번 닦아서 집어넣다가 이제는 그냥 문열림 모드로 놔둔 뒤에 다음날 아침에 빼주면 자연건조까지 더해져서 좀더 보송한 건조를 느끼고 있어요.  3. 넣고 빼는게 이렇게 귀찮은 일이였나? 그릇 모양이 일정한 집이라면 우아한 정렬이 가능했겠지만 우리집은 애들 식기도 많고 온갖 크기와 모양의 그릇이 많다보니  이게 좀 까다롭게 느껴지더라구요.  그래도 집어 넣는건 쓸수록 요령이 생기다보니 좀 나아지는것 같아요.  빼는건.. 용병을 구했습니다ㅋㅋ(10번째 사진)  ○5인가족의 사용법 5인 가족이라 평소에도 설거지거리는 넘치는 편이지만 요즘 남편이 식단조절 중이라 아침을 안먹고 나가는 관계로 평일 아침/점심엔 설거지거리가 꽤 없는 편이에요. 일반적인 가정이라면 세끼 설거지거리를 모아서 한번에 돌리는것도 상관 없는 넉넉한 크기의 12인용 식세기지만 설거지거리가 워낙 많은 우리집은 아침/점심 설거지 거리를 맨 아랫칸에 모아서 하단 세척모드로 1회 돌려주고  저녁에 전체 세척으로 1회 더 돌리니까 딱 알맞네요.  ○마무리 평소에 식세기 설치는 일부러 눈에서 띄워놓고 고려도 안하고 있었기에 이상이랑 다르다며 투덜댔지만 제 삶의 질은 확실히 한단계 이상 올라갔어요. 이제 다시는 없던 때로는 돌아갈 수 없을듯...ㅎ 그동안 집안일중에 설거지가 제일 싫다고 이야기 하던 사람으로서 이제는 빨래 접는게 제일 싫다고 자신있게 말할 수 있습니다!ㅋㅋ

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!

Comments (English): [ Installation was a headache, but the dishwasher is a product made for housewives. ] || ---------------- || You should check the specifications on the installation details page carefully, but it is very difficult to measure. If you leave it as a stand, the water supply hose, drain, and power cord will be a problem, and the specifications don't really matter, but considering built-in, both my in-laws and my parents' house, which were old houses, failed to select a location, and only our house, which was just the right size, was left, so I applied for installation, but the technician came to the pre-visit and confirmed that installation was possible. Since the parts were not available, same-day installation was impossible anyway, but it seems that the pre-visit is sometimes free, so if you really want to buy a dishwasher, but the size is tight! I don't know if it will work or not! If so, I think it would be good to inquire first. Since it was the first product to be launched, it took a long time to install due to the lack of parts, so the schedule was messed up, so I was a little resentful, but thanks to the rocket installation, the technician saved 100,000 won for the removal cost that he mentioned when he first came to the pre-visit, so my mind was slightly relieved. Instead, I sent 30,000 won for the vapor film separately, haha. It felt a bit chaotic at first, but I believe that the system will be more organized once the products of the same brand are more established on Coupang. Induction warning: The gas range and the dishwasher are not related, but there is a ventilation hole under the induction, so you have to install an induction stand to keep the distance from the dishwasher. I even made a hole to make it look pretty when I installed the induction. In the end, I had to buy a 3cm stand separately for 100,000 won and install it, so I cried a lot. Cleaning power: I heard that the dishwasher smells if you don't do a pre-cleaning, and I hate it when rice residue gets stuck in the strainer, so I'm putting a lot of effort into the pre-cleaning, and maybe that's why the cleaning power is good. Except for eggs stuck to the spatula that need to be thoroughly cleaned with a steel wool sponge, most oil and stains will be removed with the power of hot water. (7th picture) Especially, when I ordered the dishes after eating pork belly, they were so clean and nice! Water stains? The installer said I didn't have to use conditioner, so I didn't do it separately. I never noticed any stains on the dishes, but I often noticed them on the spoons. (8th picture) Likewise, I don't know if it's just my house where the dishes are stacked without any gaps, but the top cutlery tray seems to be barely dry. When I took out the top tray first, the water dripped down to the bottom, so when I took them out, I took them out starting from the bottom tray. The difference between ideal and reality On the first day of use, I felt really, really strange. After eating, I put it in and turned on the dishwasher, and when I usually would have been busy with a mountain of dishes, I sighed and felt like I had nothing to do. I read a book in my spare time, and for the first time in 10 years of marriage, I felt elegant. Ah. So that's why they call it the dishwasher aunt. I realized that. But! As I use it, my lazy nature kicks in and I keep wanting more and more things. If that's the problem, then it's a problem. 1. There are surprisingly many things that shouldn't be put in. Coated products, plastics without heat resistance, wooden utensils, and utensils that are too small. It's because of the hot water, but I thought I wouldn't have to buy kitchen detergent when I got a dishwasher, but now I have to buy two types of kitchen detergent and dishwasher detergent. 2. It doesn't dry. When I set the door open mode, the dishwasher works hard and then automatically turns off and the door opens, but when I excitedly run to it, water is still dripping on the dishes. As I found out, this was a problem that occurred because I ignored the loading method and filled the dishes too much on the first day, but there was also a problem with the dishes themselves. Flat-bottomed dishes like Corelle dishes dry well, but if there is a curve on the bottom, water collects in that area and drying fails. I have so many dishes like that at home, so in the end, the fluffy dishes I wanted! They didn't dry well. (9th photo) I used to wipe it and put it in, but now I just leave it in the open mode and take it out the next morning, and it dries naturally, so I feel it dries more fluffily. 3. Was putting it in and taking it out this much of a hassle? If the dishes were all the same shape, I could have arranged them elegantly, but since my house has a lot of children's dishes and dishes of all sizes and shapes, it felt a bit tricky. However, putting it in is getting better as I get better at it. As for taking it out, I got a mercenary. (10th photo) How to use it for a family of 5 Since we are a family of 5, we usually have a lot of dishes to wash, but since my husband is on a diet these days and goes out without eating breakfast, there aren't many dishes to wash on weekday mornings/lunches. In a typical household, it would be okay to wash all three meals at once with a 12-person dishwasher, but since our house has so many dishes to wash, we put the breakfast/lunch dishes in the bottom compartment and run it once in the bottom wash mode, and then run it once more in the full wash mode in the evening, which is just right. Finishing I usually deliberately ignored the dishwasher installation and didn't even consider it, so I grumbled that it was different from the ideal, but my quality of life has definitely improved by more than one level. Now, I don't think I can go back to the times when there were none. As someone who used to say that washing dishes was the most hated chore in the house, I can now confidently say that folding laundry is the most hated chore!
